summary: A London estate agent appears to lose landlords and sellers to placeholder Lorem ipsum text on its service cards and a 2020 date.

findings.problem: The Lettings, Sales, Property Management, Auction and New Homes cards appear to show Lorem Ipsum is simply dummy text of the printing and typesetting industry.
findings.cost: Landlords and sellers use these cards to choose an agent, and dummy text makes the agency look unfinished.

findings.problem: The footer appears to say All content 2020 Addison Townsend.
findings.cost: An old date makes visitors wonder if the agency is still active.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp appears, though an app download is mentioned.
findings.cost: Landlords and tenants with a quick question message first.
findings.fix: A one tap WhatsApp button and a valuation form.
